The Bhrihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) invites e-tender to appoint C ontractor for the aforementioned work from contractors of repute, multidisciplinary engineering organizations i.e. eminent firm, Proprietary/Partnership Firms/ Private Li mited Companies/ Public Limited Companies/Companies registered under the Indian companies’ act 2013, the contractors registered with the Bhrihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in Class D (Mech./Elect. category) or above and/or from the contractors/firms equivalent and superior classes registered in Central or State Gov ernment/Semi Govt. Bidder shall be authorized distributors/dealer of bio gen set manufacturers. Bidding Process will comprise of THREE stages. The tender document can be downloaded from GeM portal (https://g em.gov.in).

Bidders should have valid Class III Digital Signature Certificate (DSC ) obtained from any licenced Certifying Authorities (CA). However, the bidders are requested to submit the respectiv e e-tender on GeM portal (https://gem.gov.in) only. In terms of the e-tendering, a Bidder will be required to deposit through the Dema nd Draft, The scrutiny fee of tender documents payment Rs. 1888/- (Rs 1600 + 18 % GST) shall be paid b y Demand Draft only. ass will be recovered as penalty. Bidder shall be authorized distributors/dealer of bio gen set manufacturers. ance works; Similar work shall mean, the completed or ongoing works related to meachanical fabrication work in animal husbandry work etc ./ slaughter house work.” Documents Required to be submitted in packet A for Submission of Te nder:- (As per Standard Bid Document) 1. Scanned copy of Demand Draft for EMD and Tender Fee 7. Valid Tender Form 8. Valid Agreement Form 9. Annexure A,B,C in valid format 10. Valid Irrevocable Undertaking 11. Valid Undertaking for Site Visit 12. Valid Certificate for hiring equipments & machinery. sd/- General Manager ( Deonar Abattoir) .
